description: This file defines data structures and logic for wake word detection and gating, including segment representation, configuration, matching algorithms, and command extraction related to wake words in speech transcripts.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of transcribed speech with timing and text information.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for wake word detection, including triggers and timing constraints.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Result of a wake word match, including trigger end time, post-gap duration, and command text.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Contains static methods for matching wake words within transcripts and segments.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Main method to find a wake word trigger in the transcript and segments based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Extracts command text occurring after the wake word trigger.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if the input text contains any trigger phrase.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger words from the text.

methods.name: normalizeTriggers
methods.description: Normalizes trigger phrases into tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeSegments
methods.description: Normalizes speech segments into tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Converts a token to lowercase and trims punctuation for consistent matching.
